methods.description: Verify product-rule equality by evaluating both sides for known nonnegative roots.
Split a product under a square root into separate known roots.
Join roots whose radicand product is a perfect square and evaluate it.
Join two or three roots into one exact root using the product of radicands.
Use numerical counterexamples to reject corresponding general addition/subtraction rules.
Find a missing nonnegative radicand using the product rule and the inverse square/root relationship.
Apply the product rule successively to three nonnegative factors.
Use the product rule when multiplying rectangular side lengths to find area.
